Review Title: Great value; a fun way to see Portland & Columbia River Gorge
Review Text: Our family of four (two adults and two teenagers) greatly enjoyed our 75 minute Figure 8 tour on a Tuesday evening. When booking, we asked several questions via email, all of which were answered promptly and thoroughly. Though we had booked for the 5 passenger plane, we were informed the morning of our flight that that plane was out of service for maintenance and instead we would be going up in two 2 passenger planes. Our teenagers had a blast with Clay and the parents went up with Adam. Everyone was very friendly, took pictures of us with the planes and explained everything about our trip. We had good weather, hardly any turbulence, and nice visibility. We did a big loop over Portland, Oregon City, Vancouver and Milwaukie. And, also went up the Columbia River Gorge as far as the Bonneville Dam and back including seeing all the waterfalls along the way. Tour started from the small craft Airport in Troutdale, which was easy to find (35 minutes by car from downtown Portland during rush hour). There are bathrooms at the office and they offered us Capri Suns and Envi stickers. Checkin was fast with and online waiver that you complete at the office with a QR code. During the flight, sights were pointed out to us and we could ask questions and take lots of pictures. We thought this tour was a great value for the money. A fabulous way to sightsee and the perfect end to our time in Portland.

Review Title: Great experience and service, but not properly advertised
Review Text:
I first want to state that our pilot Spencer was wonderful in every way. He was very invested in our experience from start to finish, and my rating would be "excellent" if it only pertained to him. I'm being generous by saying "average," simply because I hate to reflect badly on him in any way.

My brother and I booked this tour as a Father's Day gift for our dad - planning that all 3 of us would enjoy the experience together. We were specifically seeking a helicopter ride, and booked this trip only because it was advertised as such. Although we were asked to give the weight of one person at booking, I couldn't find any information that stated a maximum weight for the group. When we arrived, our first surprise was that we could not all 3 be included in the ride. Spencer was great, and he figured out a way to allow us to book a second trip so we could still all participate, though this doubled our cost. The second surprise was that this was a plane tour instead of a helicopter tour.

Spencer did everything in his power to make this a fun outing for us, but he couldn't turn his plane into a helicopter and he had to charge us for the second trip. We made the best of a pretty disappointing and unexpectedly expensive situation, but we will not be trusting TripAdvisor descriptions in the future.

Review Title: THIS IS A MUST-DO IN PORTLAND!!! Such amazing views!
Review Text:
I had booked with Envi Adventures when the snowstorm hit back in February cancelling everything and it was no problem to get a refund. The communication with the company was spot on. We rescheduled our Portand trip for mid April and the weather was PERFECT. We even opted to book a longer aerial tour with Envi. Everything was extremely professional. The booking process and follow up emails were perfect and even let us know that if nobody is at the counterwhen we arrive, just get comfortable because they are probably prepping the plane. There was also a sign inside letting us know the same information. Would have been confusing otherwise if we arrived to an empty business.

Spencer met us at the counter and happily (maybe?! Lol!) entertained our five year old as she followed him around outside chattering to him while he put fuel in the plane and prepped it for us. She got to sit in the front seat and "fly the plane" which she was super excited about and now says she is a pilot.

We felt very safe and being somewhat familiar with aircraft, knew we were in good hands. The Cessna is not a luxury private jet. It's a simple aircraft, yet very safe. For people not familiar, it can look a little rickety but it's well maintained, comfortable.

Spencer gave us a great and informative tour of the gorge pointing out waterfalls, mountains, and landmarks with some interesting history of the area.....for us out of staters. It is well worth the price....if fact, it's a bargain and if we are ever in the Portland area again, we would gladly book another tour. I highly recommend this!!

Review Text: We are locals and know many of the sights we flew over quite well, but it was fascinating to see them from the air and discover features (lakes, buildings, geological features, sand bars) one can't see from the road, the water, or on a hike. It was also very interesting to see the extent of damage and recovery from last summer's Eagle Creek fire. Anyone interested in the geology of the area (lava flows and floods) will be fascinated by the aerial views. The pilot pointed out a number of things and kept up a running commentary throughout the flight, though as a relatively new transplant to the area he generally wasn't as familiar with the sights as we were. The weather was rather hazy so unfortunately we had no mountain views and it wasn't great for photography, but it was still a very enjoyable experience and we wished the flight duration had been longer. We would like to do the same flight again in the spring when there is more water in the waterfalls and hopefully clearer skies, as well as the Mt. Hood flight. This is definitely a memorable experience which we would recommend to others - and already have done so!

Review Text:
My husband and I wanted to do something special for our daughter's 5th birthday. she had been asking us for some time if we could go on a plane. My husband found this and we decided this would be what we were going to do. From the start it was the best experience! Our pilot was willing to help us by even making sure we all were able to get a family picture before we boarded. My daughter was so excited and just kept asking questions. He answered and there were times she even asked him to tilt the plane a little so she could see out her window better and he did. He made sure to point out all the places he thought she would really like and explained everything as we went.
When we first got there we had planned on doing a different tour but he had just got back from that one and let us know there was a lot of stuff going on because of the fires. He explained that we would not be able to have the real experience we had hoped for and offered for us to do the tour we did. I was very grateful he gave us that option and let us know what was going on. He really was concerned about us having the best experience.
I don't think any of us will forget this anytime soon. and we have already planned on going back when we have company come visit so they can have the same experience we had.
I recommend this for EVERYONE!!
